rules.statement: When a daughter accepts her father's succession, property given to her by way of dower in his lifetime is available for the debts of the deceased donor if the rest of his estate is insufficient to meet those debts.
rules.supporting_quote: "But as by reason of the admissions made at the trial in the lower Court and before us at the hearing in review, it must be assumed that Kittanduwebedde was included in the dowry deed, I would certainly consider that the defend- ants by their presence and contentions in the testamentary and administration proceedings have put forward claims as heirs to the estate, which have all the effect of an acceptance of inheritance by heirs under the Roman-Dutch Law. They left nothing undone of all procedure incumbent presently upon heirs to take the benefit of inheritance, with the consequent liability to pay the testator's debts so far as the assets in their hands should extend"
